description: Default precedence policy for cross-framework contradictions in compliance assistant responses. Essential Eight and ISM are distinct frameworks; Essential Eight is NOT a subset or alias of ISM. The default_framework is the governing framework for general questions unless a specific rule below overrides it.

rules.description: For Australia-focused identity/access control topics, prioritise Essential Eight guidance first.
For encryption at rest/transit questions in Australia scope, prioritise ISM baseline controls.
